evidenceDetails.plan6: RESOURCE_LIMITED_COMPACT_OFFLINE_CAP32_E6_V5_GPU_PROBE_FIXED passed focused tests, a real locked-TF2.4 GPU admission canary, and independent protocol review, but its training was interrupted by a host/WSL restart before the first fold completed. Its namespace is consumed and must not be resumed or reused.
evidenceDetails.plan7: Fresh Plan 7 must retain the reviewed cap32/6-epoch/six-fold protocol, use a distinct versioned namespace, and launch through a detached supervisor so terminal/session closure cannot terminate the workload. A host reboot remains a terminal failure for that fresh run; no automatic retry is allowed.
evidenceDetails.plan8: Plan 8 used the receipt-bound native ext4 stage at /home/techatat/subject-generalization-plan8-native-cache-v1-20261005 and bound it over the original E: cache path; full loader canaries and independent review passed. During fold 0 Stage 1, stdout reached batch 932/1800, but WSL memory fell to approximately 88 MB free with the 4096 MB swap fully consumed while the TF2.4 process RSS reached approximately 6.9 GB. The exact workload PID 543 was stopped once to prevent system-wide OOM; supervisor cleanup completed and the original cache remained untouched. This is a verified resource blocker, not a model-error or paper-result.
evidenceDetails.next_gate: Complete. Plan 15 is immutable and must not be retried, resumed, or reused. All six folds and the parent terminal are verified, final metrics and limitations are published, and the one operational-audit deviation is recorded without reconstructing missing historical RAM measurements. Any model-quality improvement must use a fresh versioned protocol and run namespace.
